title: Law-Specific Honest Width for Small Dose-Floor Policy Gains
banked_reason: D0.5 mathematics and rubric PASS; calibrated novelty incremental below field, paper score ceiling 5.6 < 7.4, not salvageable within scope. Independent validity gate confirmed downgraded disposition.
gap_reasons: The matched worst-law frontier concerns a shrinking gain reducible to a boundary slope and a rare-tail design moment, making it a specialized extension of established inhomogeneous-regression and directed-inference methods ([Gaïffas](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0610113), [Armstrong and Kolesár](https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.06028)). The additional Δ³n^−1/4 characterization is uniform over envelope densities but fixes the regression to one prescribed saturated piecewise-quadratic shape, which the directed contrasts explicitly reference. The n^1/12 inefficiency result defeats Bstar specifically; Bdagger has no uniform law-specific optimality guarantee across the remaining zero-margin geometries, and the directional-separation theorem supplies only a sufficient slack regime. The TL;DR accurately distinguishes these delivered results from the unresolved all-law adaptation question, so there is no stale claim that the latter is settled. The common-rank lift contributes a restricted causal interpretation rather than an additional identification theorem. The projected score reflects the narrow boundary characterization and the absence of transition rates establishing how its improvement extends to nearby laws; faithful writing cannot supply that missing contribution. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.6 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
proof_attempt_summary: The queued known-design critical-window angle overlapped banked results; its sharp-constant repair could not certify an attaining full-class band. An unknown-design rare-tail pivot yielded a matched worst-law gain frontier, an honest continuum band, a sharp saturated-quadratic boundary rate and directed attainment with a sufficient slack regime; math and rubric referees passed. Full-class adaptation and near-boundary transition rates remain open, novelty was calibrated incremental against field, and the independent validity gate confirmed downgraded banking before any Lean formalization.
tldr: For the exact causal dose-floor gain, the established worst-law risk and honest-width frontier is \(\Delta^3n^{-1/6}+\min\{\epsilon\Delta^3,n^{-1/2}\Delta^2\}\) over the fixed Bernoulli class and every \(0<\Delta\le\min\{1/2,n^{-1/4}\}\). Law-specific honesty has a distinct boundary phenomenon: an explicit lower-range, saturated-quadratic regression has optimal width \(\Delta^3n^{-1/4}\), while the original slope-times-moment band has width \(\Delta^3n^{-1/6}\) there. Two directed conditional contrasts yield a computable globally honest band attaining the smaller boundary rate and retaining the worst-law width bound. A local directional separation restriction restores the matched slope-loaded rate. Uniform attainment at every original law by some other computable family remains unresolved.
gap: The carried internal gain-band result excludes horizons below its reporting cutoff and uses that cutoff to absorb lower-tail design uncertainty. Its outcome-only converse does not match the missing design component.
fill: The kernel retains an integrated treatment moment, supplies a mass-preserving density experiment and a total continuum band, and targets a uniform transition from \(\epsilon=0\) to uncertain design. Reference-law adaptation remains a separate first-class question with joint likelihood inversion as its handle.
